caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot rendered in shades of gray, with detailed shading and fine linework suggesting a metallic surface. The teapot features an elongated, curved spout extending to the right and a large, rounded handle on the left, which appears darker than the rest of the vessel. The lid is dome-shaped with a finial on top, and the body of the teapot includes ornate decorative bands with patterns, one of which features shield-like and floral motifs. There are two names written in capital letters below the teapot, "D.V. VOORHIS" and "ED. J. GILSLEIDER," the first of which is accompanied by a small diamond-shaped mark. The drawing is set on off-white paper, and no additional objects or backgrounds are present.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
